jobs.title: SoC Software Engineer - New College Grad 2027
jobs.description: We are looking for a New College Graduate SoC Software Engineer to help shape the future of accelerated computing within CPU/Data Center. Imagine developing foundational technology for tomorrow’s AI factories, next-generation data centers, autonomous platforms—and even data centers in space. Your work will span hardware, firmware, operating systems, and applications as you help bring sophisticated server products from early silicon through deployment. Contribute to system software architecture and collaborate with internal teams to integrate new capabilities across the software stack. Work closely with architecture, ASIC, firmware, platform, and new product introduction teams to understand requirements and bring new computing platforms to life. Investigate challenging hardware and software issues, develop creative solutions, and improve the performance, reliability, power efficiency, and serviceability of our platforms. What we need to see: Pursuing or recently completed a BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field—or equivalent experience. Strong C or C++ programming skills and an understanding of object-oriented design. Familiarity with low-level systems software, device drivers, firmware, embedded software, or hardware-facing programming. A foundational understanding of processor and computer architecture, preferably ARM. Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, with curiosity about how hardware and software work together. Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment. Ways to stand out from the crowd: Knowledge of Linux systems or kernel internals. Understanding of server, PC, embedded, or other complex computing architectures. Experience with SoC development, pre-silicon environments, silicon bring-up, or hardware validation through coursework, research, internships, or personal projects. Experience contributing to a team software project, open-source project, technical competition, or substantial personal project. Exposure to AI, automation, or data-driven techniques for accelerating validation, analyzing failures, or improving system reliability. Are you dedicated, upbeat and dynamic with excellent analytical ability? Are you an engineer passionate and highly motivated about solving complex problems? jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: Overview ACES CØDE is a Microsoft engineering organization focused on reducing operational demand across the Microsoft Cloud, including but not limited to the avoidable support cases, repeated troubleshooting, and manual interventions that arise when cloud products, platforms, or processes do not work as intended. Our mission is to engineer this demand out of the Microsoft Cloud by turning customer and operational signals into lasting product improvements, intelligent diagnostics, autonomous resolution systems, and AI-powered capabilities. As cloud services grow in scale and complexity, we are moving beyond simply reacting to problems after they occur. We work to understand why operational demand exists, prevent it at the source where possible, resolve it autonomously when it does occur, and continuously learn from those signals to make our products and support experiences more reliable. We look for teammates who can navigate ambiguity, reason from data and customer signals, work across technical and organizational boundaries, and turn complex problems into durable, measurable outcomes. Within this mission, the ACES CØDE engineering team is building domain-specific agents and services that are transforming Azure customer support from reactive, human-dependent workflows toward AI-first systems capable of resolving customer issues at Azure scale. We are seeking an Applied AI Engineer to help build the next generation of production agentic AI services that resolve customer issues faster, reduce avoidable support demand, and improve the reliability and scalability of AI-first support experiences. You will take product specifications and turn them into production-ready, scalable AI services — working with LLM orchestration, multi-agent coordination, and RAG-based systems. You will ship production services that directly impact Azure customers. Every day, our customers stake their business and reputation on our cloud. You can help our team provide our customers with the world-class cloud services they need to succeed. Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more.
